# Scripted ordinary-decoration base normalization

These 48 public cases use the unchanged MathJax 3.2.2 oracle embedded in D2 v0.8.1 (source commit `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`). `generate-scripted-decoration.cjs` rehashes all three assets before rendering. The primary fixture retains every original reference, including errors, kind/text/explicit attributes/own properties and ordered children; comparison does not claim inherited/default/flag equality for public compiler trees.

The accepted baseline is `c57a3ee4c3db310de4d33a5b0ab9f4c1d9da1dde`. The production change follows `ParseUtil.underOver` lines 375–386 after the existing direct `checkMovableLimits`: an embellished munder, mover or munderover gets explicit core lspace/rspace zero, then a new row containing a zero-child mo with rspace zero and the identical incoming base. Side-script families and grouped top-level bases remain excluded. The existing node-specific `limitsCore` supplies the primary coreMO policy. Braces, bar's Accent dispatch, permission/subsupOK, attachment, renderer and core traversal helpers remain unchanged.

All 22 changed complete SVGs become raw-primary exact. Overall, 44 of 48 SVGs are raw primary; the four named D071 permission-error cases retain their complete accepted SVG and tree. There are two raw explicit projections and zero raw own-property projections. The remaining valid-case differences are finite, listed per-node attribute/property maps that are byte-value-equivalent to accepted maps. Baseline paths explicitly account for the source-shaped new row and final moveLimits family consequence. Every other kind, text, child and field remains exact primary. No broad omission, wrapper stripping or geometry tolerance is used.

Only the two scripted-overline substitutions in the inherited D072 fixture are upgraded. Its untouched primary references now produce 38 raw SVGs; the other 58 complete SVGs and raw captured compiler trees stay byte-identical to accepted D072. D071 remains separate.

The 24 registered private controls invoke the actual unmodified primary ParseUtil.underOver with registered factory nodes, preserving complete normalized maps, dynamic embellishment/spacelike state, selected core identity and every original node's parent/child identities. They cover all eligible and excluded families, nonembellished bases, nonzero row core, selected maction core, transparent wrappers, zero-child input, own movablelimits, and attached-parent/sibling cases. The Go input builder reproduces registered TeXAtom's own ORD property. The fixture also retains primary outer permission, but that D071 field is not introduced by this change. Twelve real constructor controls exercise all six ordinary commands in both modes. Parser-phase observations verify movable under/over construction precedes final filtering; no side-family lift is added.

Mutation controls separately reject a text-bearing empty token, cloned base, generic core-to-text descent and widened side-family predicate. Accepted production, with unchanged new public tests, must fail exactly the 22 new fixes plus the two inherited upgrades; compiler failures are not regression evidence.
